code: for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then g.Enabled=false end end local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local VS=require(RS.Shared.VoyageScene) local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) local SR=require(RS.Shared.SeaRoutes) local PD=require(RS.Shared.Ports) task.spawn(function() local ok,err=pcall(VS.play,{shipId="galleon",steam=false,days=30,path=SR.path("lisbon","london",PD.Ports),fromName="Lisbon",toName="London",makeShip=PS.makeShip,place=PS.placeModel,escorts=2,weatherId="clear",event={kind="merchant"}}) workspace:SetAttribute("VoyageDone",tostring(ok)..tostring(err)) end) return "started"

local c=workspace.CurrentCamera local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('VoyageScene') local sh=f and f:FindFirstChild('VoyageShip') local v,on=c:WorldToViewportPoint(sh:GetPivot().Position) return 'type='..tostring(c.CameraType)..' camdist='..tostring((c.CFrame.Position-sh:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude)..' vp='..tostring(v)..' on='..tostring(on)
